rationale: The assistant immediately and correctly identified that a ~3h40 Eco 40-60 cycle is by design ('they use less energy by heating more gently and washing for longer'), matching the hidden truth, and asked the one proportionate confirming question about completion. It used the customer's second-turn evidence (finishes, spins, clean clothes, Cottons 40 at 2 hours, no codes) to confirm normal behaviour and set sensible criteria for when it would become a fault. It hedged appropriately ('likely a standard or quick programme'), invented nothing, recommended no parts and no return. Minor omission: it did not point to the TimeManager/time-saver option or the manual's programme table, which would have added practical value.
